label: PoE 1 3.30
notes: Catalog extracted from client 3.30.0.4.3. The catalog adds and removes no bases or modifiers: 53 Veiled jewel modifiers gain the unveiled_mod tag, and 9 map modifiers that add worlds (Mirage, Beyond, Sentinel, Delirium Mirror and Wildwood) cannot roll on infected maps. Two currency items are added, Originator's Exalted Orb and Primordial Exalted Orb; crafting does not offer either. Crafting mechanics are unchanged; the engine is rebuilt from the same crafting code with a newer version of its schema validation library. Projects on the 3.29 era keep r17 and its catalog.

label: PoE 2 (client 4.5)
notes: Catalog extracted from client 0.5.5.10. Only the client build and source hashes change; the bases, modifiers and crafting mechanics are the same as r19's. The engine is rebuilt from the same crafting code with a newer version of its schema validation library. Revisions r1 through r19 retain their original immutable engines, catalogs and behavior; equipment prices remain manual.
